title: Zscaler Workload Communications Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Effective April 19, 2024, Licensing and Fair Use Policy for Zscaler Workload Communications has been replaced by the Licensing and Fair Use Policy for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and/or Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), respectively. Please refer to the licensing metrics for “Workload” under those policies.
Contact Zscaler Sales or Customer Success if you have any questions.
